name: Remarrying An Ex Spouse
overview: Scripture teaches that marriage is a sacred covenant witnessed by the Lord, as emphasized in Malachi 2:14, and that divorce was permitted under specific circumstances, such as uncleanness, as seen in Deuteronomy 24:1. However, Jesus clarifies in Matthew 5:32 and 19:9 that remarriage after divorce, except in cases of sexual immorality, constitutes adultery. Jeremiah 3:1 also highlights the seriousness of returning to an ex-spouse, likening it to spiritual unfaithfulness, underscoring the call to honor the permanence and purity of the marital covenant.
